moments.frontstage: Contact center authenticates and opens a claim or investigation; written follow-up may be required within 10 Business Days for phone claims

fail_points.text: No evidence of an in-app virtual assistant handling money-movement disputes; phone remains the escalation path.

exceptions.customer_experience: Email same day; cancelled after one attempt

After the wire is sent it cannot be cancelled; the customer may ask Citi to recall it ('time is of the essence' for scams); funds return only if the beneficiary bank agrees, possibly less fees; returned foreign-currency wires come back in USD at Citi's rate on the date of return

exceptions.trigger: Unauthorized online wire after account takeover (phishing/SIM swap) — NY AG allegations
exceptions.customer_experience: Alleged (NY AG complaint as summarized by the court): Citi locks the account and tells customers to visit a branch, delaying investigation by 'hours or days'; requires a notarized 'Affidavit of Unauthorized Online Wire Transfer' before investigating; investigators sometimes do not speak with the customer and respond after 30-60 days
exceptions.bank_handling: Alleged: denials rely on details from the customer's own affidavit; investigations 'ineffective, pro forma, and not reasonably tailored'; form letters 'merely assert, in one or two sentences, one of a few predetermined grounds for denying claims'. Citi's position: wires governed by UCC 4A, with which it complied
exceptions.resolution: Litigation pending: EFTA claims I-II survived MTD (Jan 21, 2025); interlocutory appeal at 2d Cir.

exceptions.trigger: Wire request rejected (over daily limit, insufficient available funds, incomplete/unclear information, or identity/authority not confirmed)
exceptions.customer_experience: Notified in the online session or afterwards; same-day email for domestic wires
exceptions.bank_handling: Citi may reject without cause or prior notice; unexecuted request is cancelled after one attempt

assessment: Legal terms are thorough; UX-level documentation (screens, statuses, OTP) is absent publicly.

terms.cutoffs: Same business day if submitted before 6:45 PM ET (domestic) / 6:00 PM ET (international) [S917]
